Docs/ Theme development

Themes overview

Bundled Go themes versus theme packages, and what a theme can control.

Pursae renders the site with Go html/template files. A theme is a set of those templates plus assets, a description of the widget areas, menu locations and Customizer options it offers, and the styles and scripts it loads. There are two kinds:

Bundled Go themes Theme packages
Examples Twenty Sixteen, Twenty Seventeen, Twenty Twenty, Twenty Twenty-One, Hello Golementor, Classic anything you upload
Where compiled into the binary (web/themes/<slug>/ + a theme_<slug>.go) <data>/themes/<slug>/ (WPGO_THEMES_DIR)
functions.php equivalent Go code: a *Theme registered at start-up with hooks for wp_head, body classes, template data theme.json: everything a Go theme registers in code, declared as data
Install ship with Pursae Appearance › Themes › Add Theme › Upload, or from the marketplace
Code yes (Go, reviewed with the core) none — templates, CSS, JS, images. Not signed; verified by SHA-256

This section is about theme packages: what you write to make a theme for Pursae. Everything a package can express is also what the bundled Classic theme uses, so its templates in web/themes/classic/templates are the reference implementation.

What a theme controls

  • the markup of every page kind: index, single, page, archive, search, 404 and the parts header, footer, sidebar, comments (templates);
  • its stylesheets and scripts, editor styles and preloaded fonts (styles and scripts);
  • widget areas and menu locations;
  • Customizer sections and settings with live preview (customizer);
  • what the block editor knows about it: colour palette, wide alignment, supports (block editor support).

What the core does for every theme

The core builds the whole page model — the document title, wp_head() output, body classes, the loop, pagination, comments, menus, widget areas, the admin bar — and the theme decides how to print it. A theme never queries the database or sanitises input; it formats data the core already prepared, which is why packages can be code-free and safe to install.

Golementor themes

The page builder brings its own base theme, Hello Golementor, and can save a complete site design (header, footer, templates, global styles) as a theme of its own (Golementor). Those live in the database, not as packages.

Editing on a live site

Appearance › Theme File Editor edits any theme's templates and CSS in place; saves are validated and rolled back on error (file editor).

Start with your first theme.
